'''

args.generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
months=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']
items=[];control=[]
seen=set()
while len(items)<120:
    m=random.randrange(12); k=random.randint(1,5)
    if (m,k) in seen: continue
    seen.add((m,k))
    items.append({"prompt":f"Q: Which month comes {k} month{'s' if k>1 else ''} after {months[m]}?\nA:","answer":" "+months[(m+k)%12]})
seen=set()
while len(control)<120:
    x=random.randint(1,40); k=random.randint(1,5)
    if (x,k) in seen: continue
    seen.add((x,k))
    control.append({"prompt":f"Q: Which number comes {k} number{'s' if k>1 else ''} after {x}?\nA:","answer":" "+str(x+k)})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
